replication_status: exact (authors' code output 0.0401408 (0.0223432), N 8784, equals printed Table 4 column (1) 0.040 (0.022), N 8,784, to the printed decimals; verified against the article Nov 4 2026)
outcome_description: ln(1 + total kidney transplants at the origin and destination airport areas)
notes: Origin-destination airport-pair x year panel 2002-2017, balanced. pair_id = integer code of OrgDestAirport (unit FE and cluster, as vce(cl OrgDestAirport)). gyear = EventYear for treated pairs (treatment_pair==1), NA for never-treated control pairs; D = 1[year >= gyear] equals the authors' TreatmentAfter on every row (checked). Treatment is absorbing (no switch-offs). The 2002 cohort is treated in the first panel year (always-treated): kept in TWFE/BJS samples as in the authors' regression; did::att_gt drops it. Data: shipped RobustOutcomeAnalysis.dta (pairs with donor-disposition data for both airports in all 16 years). Authors' line 277: reg lnKidneysTransplanted TreatmentAfter TxYear* ODPair* if airport_dist >= 800, vce(cl OrgDestAirport). fixest: 0.0401408 (0.0223432 Stata dof), N 8,784, adj. R2 0.8782; published 0.040 (0.022), N 8,784, adj. R2 0.878. 549 pairs; cohorts 2002:5, 2003:2, 2004:1, 2005:7, 2006:2, 2008:2, 2012:8, 2013:5, 2014:8, 2015:13, 2016:2, 2017:2. Abstract mentions the result qualitatively ('a net increase in the total number of kidney transplants'). Expected run_spec TWFE = 0.0401408 / 0.4817869 = 0.08332.
